articles.summary: We were excited to organise the 1st Asian PocketQube Workshop. The event was a half day event with 6 speakers from 4 different PocketQube building organisations. The event was hosted at Skyscanner’s Singapore office and we would like to thank them for sponsoring the event! Slides Silvana Radu, T
